name: Set I/O Priority for Current Game
description: Assigns higher I/O priority to the current game process so it gets faster access to disk reads and writes
commands:
# --- CONFIG ---
$proc = "GameName.exe"                 # replace with the detected exe
$base = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\$proc"
$path = Join-Path $base "PerfOptions"
New-Item -Path $path -Force | Out-Null
# IoPriority: 3 = High, 2 = Normal, 1 = Low, 0 = VeryLow
Set-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name "IoPriority" -Type DWord -Value 3 -Force
revert22H2:
$proc = "GameName.exe"
$path = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\$proc\PerfOptions"
Remove-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name "IoPriority" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
